title: Board protocol version
description: The board protocol version a message follows, as major.minor. A receiver supports major 1 and accepts any of its minors (design decision 2). A minor keeps the major's meaning: it may add fields and enum values, make a required field optional, and lift or add a limit. Every message refuses what it does not define or allow, so a receiver still on an older minor refuses a newer minor's additions as schema errors, and one on a newer minor refuses what a limit that minor added excludes. A minor is therefore used only once both ends, the board page and board-host, have it, which holds because the session process that runs board-host also serves the board page.
